name: warm dusk
notes: The starter game's palette: a floating island at dusk. Base = moss, dark moss, rock, path. Accents = amber and autumn orange, kept for things that matter (pickups, the goal). Shadow is the cool violet under the island; light is the warm sun. Replace with the look from GREAT.md (or start from: node tools/assets/palette-from.mjs <image>). Used by restyle.mjs --palette and look.mjs --in-game.
